title: Web Server Process Spawning a Shell
author: WinstonRedGuard -- sigma plugin observed rules (derived from breach corpus)
description: Shared detection for 6 actors with an observed T1190 incident: cl0p, killsec, nightspire, nova, play, rhysida. The logic is a generic pattern, not the documented tradecraft of these actors, so a hit does not say which actor, if any, is responsible. Merged on 2026-09-30 from 6 single-actor rules with identical logic (their ids are listed under related).
